column15: bit 0 = Reserved; bit 1 = Motor stopped; bit 2 = Run status (running); bit 3 = Reserved; bit 4 = Reserved; bit 5 = Auto mode status (Modbus control); bit 6 = Fault status; bit 7 = Reserved; bit 8 = Reserved; bit 9 = Reserved; bit 10 = Reserved; bit 11 = DI Start active; bit 12 = DI Stop active; bit 13 = DI Reset active; bit 14 = TOR status (bypass closed); bit 15 = Ready to start

bit 0 = Reset possible on active event; bit 1 = Software fault; bit 2 = Shunt fault; bit 3 = By-pass open (does not close); bit 4 = Softstarter overload; bit 5 = Phase loss; bit 6 = Bad network quality; bit 7 = Current loss; bit 8 = Fieldbus fault; bit 9 = Low supply voltage; bit 10 = High current; bit 11 = Motor overload; bit 12 = Locked rotor protection; bit 13 = Underload protection; bit 14 = Reserved; bit 15 = Reserved

column7: Parameter-write errors; bits 8-15 fault code (line number or parameter number).
